teamMembers.name: Emily Rogers
teamMembers.bio: Hi! I'm Emily, the founder of LashPop Studios. I have owned LashPop and have been creating custom lash extension sets for 10 years. My signature style is soft, wispy, natural lashes (especially in brown). I love helping women of all ages and stages of life feel confident and beautiful in a way that never feels overdone. Creating a calm, welcoming studio environment and providing the best customer experience is just as important to me as the services themselves. My goal is for LashPop to feel like a place both clients and our team truly love being in. On my days off, you'll usually find me cozy at home reading, baking, crafting, or playing the piano (basically an 80-year-old at heart).

teamMembers.name: Kelly Katona
teamMembers.bio: Hi, I'm Kelly! I specialize in lash extensions and permanent jewelry and have been in the beauty industry for over 4 years. I love the artistry behind creating customized lash sets designed to fit each client's unique features and preferences. If you're looking for lashes that are soft and natural-looking, but noticeable in the best way, I'm your girl. I also own Junie Jewelry Co, a permanent jewelry experience designed to celebrate people and life with high quality pieces made to last. I thrive in attention to detail and love bringing a little sparkle to every gathering. There is nothing I love more than noticing and curating beauty in all forms and creating ways for people to feel and experience it for themselves. When I'm not in the studio, you'll find me traveling somewhere new, hosting themed parties, or spending time with the people I love, and always with an iced matcha in hand.

teamMembers.name: Renee Belton
teamMembers.bio: Hi, I'm Renee. I've been a licensed esthetician for 11 years and I specialize in brow laminations, brow shaping, waxing, tinting, microblading, and lash lifts. My favorite service is brow laminations—it's such a satisfying treatment with instant, beautiful results that transform the brow while still looking natural. I love how it enhances each client's unique brow shape for a fuller, lifted look without heavy makeup or permanent changes. What I love most about my job is enhancing natural beauty while helping clients feel confident, and providing a space to relax and care for themselves. On my days off, I enjoy antique shopping, being outdoors, relaxing at home, and going to the gym.

teamMembers.name: Grace Ramos
teamMembers.bio: Hi, I'm Grace! I've been working in the medical field since 2015 and started NaturTox in 2024, expanding my skills into aesthetics. I specialize in Botox injections, wellness injections and liquid IVs. I love treatments that make clients feel confident in their own skin—forehead and between the eyes are favorites for satisfying results, but my secret weapon is the lower face for a snatched jawline. What I love most is genuinely connecting with each client—every appointment is more than a treatment, it's a relationship and a chance to help someone feel more confident. On my days off I enjoy being outside, creating memories at the beach or park with my family, and family meals.
